audit.definition: Correct original CSV row 5 latitude to 34.5 N and row 8 longitude to 146 E from Yamamoto & Kanamatsu (2001), p.56 and coring-location maps. Preserve 7 and 6 cm confirmed by Yamamoto & Aoki (2002), Tables 1/2, p.31 and correlations p.32. Encode CSV 43 upper 10 cm; CSV 52 lower 3 cm; CSV 53 lower 6.7 cm following Table S2, retaining the primary-paper 6.5–7 cm conflict; CSV 55 lower 7 cm as a preservation sensitivity. Keep all other quantitative records and the six excluded pseudo rows. Fill S2 source references without changing row order.

prior.name: baseline
prior.kernel_weights: Symmetric Dirichlet(total concentration kernel_concentration) over Gaussian, exponential, power components, shared across fans
prior.noise: HalfNormal(noise_scale); broad-error fraction Beta(1,9), fourfold residual SD
prior.interpretation: Proper modelling assumptions, not extra observations or geological facts. Identical prior specification for every eruption.

volume.interpretation: 95% equal-tailed Bayesian credible interval conditional on this likelihood, prior and field family. Includes parameter and fan uncertainty; excludes unknown systematic preservation, sampling and source-attribution bias. Not dense-rock equivalent or ignimbrite volume.

diagnostics.interpretation: Rank-normalized split R-hat and bulk/tail ESS across independent chains. Fan labels are exchangeable; field and volume diagnostics are used instead. Passing diagnostics does not prove global mode exploration or model correctness.
diagnostics.assessment: R-hat <1.01, bulk/tail ESS >=400, zero divergences, every chain's energy BFMI >=0.3. Maximum-depth saturation is a separate efficiency warning.

validation.interpretation: Same four geographic outer folds and buffer as the regional peers. Entire posterior is refitted with fixed generic priors using training observations only. No response-based inner tuning is used. Heldout observation prediction does not validate total volume in unobserved regions.

source_checks.normalization: Analytical circular kernels; component centres can move away from the vent.

mass_partition.interpretation: Geometry-screened fractions, not fractions validated by data. Quantiles of parts do not add to quantiles of the total. Sobol integration error is separate from posterior uncertainty.

reproducibility.normalization: Whole WGS84 Earth; total mass is the volume parameter. Source fans use analytical radial and checked periodic angular integrals; displaced/envelope models use analytical integrals. No map bounds or isopach cutoff enter inference.
